data.one_liner: A wrapper for scrollable widgets that triggers a callback when reaching the end of the page.
data.what_it_does: It wraps any ScrollView subclass, ListView, GridView, or RefreshIndicator and triggers a callback function when the user scrolls near the bottom of the page. It allows configuring a custom scroll offset in pixels from the bottom to trigger the callback early.
use_when: You need to implement infinite scrolling or pagination for lists and grids.
You want to load more items when reaching the end of a ScrollView.
avoid_when: You need complex state management solutions for your pagination data.
You are not using a subclass of ScrollView or a compatible wrapper widget.
strengths: Simple wrapper widget approach with minimal configuration.
Supports custom scroll offset thresholds for triggering the callback.
Compatible with ListView, GridView, and RefreshIndicator.
weaknesses: Lacks built-in state management for loading states, errors, or pagination metadata.
Limited documentation regarding edge cases with dynamic content sizing.
